author: ItzPhamPlayzMCYT
body:
Hi

So recently I have been working on some nebula strategies. And I was thinking to myself "Wouldn't it be so awesome to have like an 8 man team, all friends not random people all in Skype/Teamspeak and have nebula positions" be that I mean "left Monument" "offensive rush" "center field". So I was wondering if there is such things as clans or team battle (don't know the name). So please tell in the comments/replys if you know anything about this or if I for example could start a clan.

Thankyou

title: How to Join A Clan/Team

replies.author: Spartemex
replies.body: Just put up a thread with the roster of you team, titled [CLOSED]yourteamname[TEAM].  The closed tag says that you are currently not open for team applications.
replies.body_tagged: Just put up a thread with the roster of you team, titled [CLOSED]yourteamname[TEAM].  The closed tag says that you are currently not open for team applications.

replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body: There are already some teams made. They consist of 8 starters, and 4 subs. There has not been an official tourney announced, but there will hopfully be one in the future. If you are curious on how to structure a team here is an example, http://avicus.net/forums/ac45ee12e.
